images.title: Scouts and guides in rows
images.purpose: Show the same crowd counted two ways: 4 × 5 + 3 × 5 and (4 + 3) × 5.
images.composition: A single block of dot rows, the upper rows teal and the lower rows amber, with a bracket on the left.
exact_structure: A grid of dots, 7 rows by 5 columns, 35 dots in all.
The top 4 rows (20 dots) are teal #0072B2, labelled Scouts at the right.
The bottom 3 rows (15 dots) are amber #E69F00, labelled Guides at the right.
A reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket on the left of all 7 rows, labelled 4 + 3.
rejection: the colour split other than 4 teal rows and 3 amber rows
images.takeaway: Add the rows first and multiply by 5, or multiply each and add: the same 35.
images.description: Seven rows of five dots, four teal and three amber, with a bracket on the rows.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text on the general rule.
images.teaching_notes: Count rows of 5 in two ways and see they agree.

image_decisions.why: An array shows both ways of counting at once.
